data.title: Names beside the coat rack

memoryNodes.cue: Each team has its own leader.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 每个小组都有自己的负责人。

data.situation:
On Wednesday, Maya took Lin through the hall's front door. The coat rack was exactly where she had promised. Beside it stood a desk with two lists. One was for people taking part in the afternoon workshop; the other recorded who had come to that evening's planning meeting. Lin put her coat on a hook and looked for Maya's name. Workshop participants: please collect a name card from the entrance desk.
Meeting attendees: please sign the sheet beside the coat rack.
Volunteers should report to their respective team leaders. The entrance team will meet beside the desk; the stall team will meet in the courtyard. Maya: The stall holders bring their own goods. We handle the coordination between the stall team and the entrance team.
Lin: Is there any particular reason the entrance team meets so early?
Maya: A coach arrives at ten. We need the signs in place before then.
Lin: I can come at nine thirty. A regular meeting of the hall committee took place on the first Wednesday of each month. Maya regularly helped at these meetings, although the market itself happened only once a year. During the final week, she checked the shared messages frequently: a missing table or a late delivery could affect more than one team. Lin understood why a name on one list was not the whole job.

readingBlocks.en: On Wednesday, Maya took Lin through the hall's front door. The coat rack was exactly where she had promised. Beside it stood a desk with two lists. One was for people taking part in the afternoon workshop; the other recorded who had come to that evening's planning meeting. Lin put her coat on a hook and looked for Maya's name.
readingBlocks.zh: 周三，玛雅带林走进会堂前门。衣架果然在她说过的位置。旁边的桌上放着两张名单。一张登记参加下午工作坊的人；另一张记录来参加当晚筹备会议的人。林把外套挂在钩子上，寻找玛雅的名字。

readingBlocks.en:
Workshop participants: please collect a name card from the entrance desk.
Meeting attendees: please sign the sheet beside the coat rack.
Volunteers should report to their respective team leaders. The entrance team will meet beside the desk; the stall team will meet in the courtyard.
readingBlocks.zh:
工作坊参与者：请到入口桌领取姓名卡。
会议出席者：请在衣架旁的表格上签到。
志愿者请向各自的小组负责人报到。入口组在桌旁集合；摊位组在院子里集合。
readingBlocks.title: On the desk

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: The stall holders bring their own goods. We handle the coordination between the stall team and the entrance team.
Lin: Is there any particular reason the entrance team meets so early?
Maya: A coach arrives at ten. We need the signs in place before then.
Lin: I can come at nine thirty.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：摊主会带来自己的货物。我们负责摊位组与入口组之间的协调。
林：入口组那么早集合，有什么特定原因吗？
玛雅：十点有辆大巴到达。我们需要在那之前摆好指示牌。
林：我可以九点半来。

readingBlocks.en: A regular meeting of the hall committee took place on the first Wednesday of each month. Maya regularly helped at these meetings, although the market itself happened only once a year. During the final week, she checked the shared messages frequently: a missing table or a late delivery could affect more than one team. Lin understood why a name on one list was not the whole job.
readingBlocks.zh: 会堂委员会每月第一个周三都有例会。玛雅经常在这些会议上帮忙，尽管集市本身一年只办一次。最后一周，她频繁查看共享消息：少一张桌子或一次送货延误，都可能影响不止一个小组。林明白了，名字出现在名单上并不等于事情就做完了。

glossary.note: 单复数participant/participants共用一个单位；强调参与，不把复数算新词。
glossary.example: Each participant collects a name card before the workshop.
glossary.exampleZh: 每位参与者在工作坊开始前领取姓名卡。

externalEvidence.definition: someone who takes part in an activity

glossary.note: 本事件为出席筹备会；与participant有重叠，不人为编造绝对边界。
glossary.example: Each attendee signs the meeting sheet.
glossary.exampleZh: 每位出席者在会议表上签到。

externalEvidence.definition: a person who is present and participates in a meeting

glossary.zh: 不同人员或部分之间的协调
glossary.note: 不可数名词，coordination between teams；此处不是身体动作协调。
glossary.example: Good coordination keeps the entrance and stall teams working together.
glossary.exampleZh: 良好的协调让入口组与摊位组配合工作。

externalEvidence.definition: the regulation of diverse elements into an integrated and harmonious operation

glossary.note: respective + 复数名词：每组对应自己的负责人；不教respectful等派生词为同义词。
glossary.example: Volunteers report to their respective team leaders.
glossary.exampleZh: 志愿者向各自的小组负责人报到。

glossary.note: 本句是specific义，指某一个具体原因；与详细、挑剔的用法分开。
glossary.example: Is there any particular reason the entrance team meets early?
glossary.exampleZh: 入口组早集合有什么特定原因吗？

externalEvidence.definition: separate and distinct from others of the same group or category

glossary.zh: 按固定规律重复发生的
glossary.note: 形容会议有固定周期；不是regular客人的名词义。
glossary.example: The committee holds a regular monthly meeting.

glossary.note: 这里表示经常参与，源R00209为often；不强迫每一次都完全相同。
glossary.example: Maya regularly helps at the committee meetings.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅经常在委员会的会议上帮忙。

externalEvidence.findingZh: 表示often的经常义，原R00209和本句一致；不强制固定时刻。

glossary.note: 强调查看频率较高；没有规定固定时刻。
glossary.example: Maya checks the shared messages frequently during the final week.
glossary.exampleZh: 最后一周玛雅频繁查看共享消息。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Direct a workshop participant to the name cards and a meeting attendee to the sign-in sheet.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 引导工作坊参与者领取姓名卡，引导会议出席者去签到。
acceptableAnswers: Each participant should collect a name card. Each meeting attendee should sign the sheet beside the coat rack.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell the volunteers how the teams are organised and why the team leaders matter.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 告诉志愿者小组如何安排，以及负责人为何重要。
acceptableAnswers: Please report to your respective team leaders. They handle coordination between the teams.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain the reason for the early meeting and when the committee normally meets.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 说明提前集合的原因，以及委员会通常何时开会。
acceptableAnswers: There is a particular reason: the coach arrives at ten. The committee also has a regular monthly meeting.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

transferPrompt.cue: You help at a library often and check its messages many times during a busy week. Explain the two habits.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 你经常在图书馆帮忙，并在忙碌的一周频繁查看消息。说明这两个习惯。
acceptableAnswers: I regularly help at the library, and I check the messages frequently during busy weeks.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法
